name: AI in Design Report 2026
summary: Designer Fund report on how design teams use AI — 900+ designers surveyed, chapters on tools, craft and teams, plus case study videos.
description: The second annual research report from Designer Fund in partnership with Foundation Capital on how design teams are adapting to AI. It draws on 900+ survey responses from designers in 60+ countries and 25+ interviews with practitioners and leaders, and is organised into three chapters — Tools (toolstack shakeup), Craft (designers coding, speed vs quality), Teams (blurring roles, hiring) — plus filmed case studies with the design teams at Anthropic, Framer, Linear, Notion, Shopify, Sierra and Stripe. A markdown version of the report can be downloaded.
contains: video case studies at Sierra, Linear, Shopify, Stripe, Anthropic; Notion and Framer coming soon
markdown version of the report downloadable
